0022600163.text: The Bulls (1-5) visit the 76ers (5-1) on a four-game losing streak, sitting 5th in the Central and 14th in the East, while Philadelphia has won two straight and sits 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (out, hamstring) and Dailyn Swain (day-to-day, back soreness, game-time decision), and Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and LeBron James (out, back). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Bulls won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, and their last meeting, on March 25, 2026 in Philadelphia, ended with the Bulls losing 157-137.
